actions.value:
. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; export LC_ALL=C; out=/home/probe/evidence/official-screenshot-package-round10; test ! -e "$out"; mkdir "$out"; date -u +%FT%T.%N; cat /proc/uptime; apt-cache --version; apt-cache policy gnome-screenshot > "$out/policy.txt"; cat "$out/policy.txt"; candidate=$(awk '$1=="Candidate:" {n++; value=$2} END {if(n!=1) exit 1; print value}' "$out/policy.txt"); printf 'GNOME_SCREENSHOT_CANDIDATE=%s
' "$candidate"; if test "$candidate" = '(none)'; then printf 'GNOME_SCREENSHOT_NO_CANDIDATE
'; else apt-cache show "gnome-screenshot=$candidate" > "$out/package.txt"; cat "$out/package.txt"; printf 'SOURCE_METADATA_START
'; if apt-cache showsrc gnome-screenshot > "$out/source.txt" 2> "$out/source.stderr"; then cat "$out/source.txt"; printf 'SOURCE_METADATA_RC=0
'; else rc=$?; cat "$out/source.txt"; cat "$out/source.stderr"; printf 'SOURCE_METADATA_RC=%s
' "$rc"; fi; printf 'SOURCE_METADATA_END
'; fi; if command -v gnome-screenshot; then dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Architecture} ${Status}
' gnome-screenshot; else printf 'GNOME_SCREENSHOT_STILL_NOT_INSTALLED
'; fi; sha256sum "$out"/*; printf 'ROUND10_OFFICIAL_SCREENSHOT_PACKAGE_METADATA_COMPLETE
'
